title: Daquavis fan-made texture pack
description: Daquavis-style texturepack for pvp and minigames
body:
This is a Daquavis fan-made texture pack.
It changes some Minecraft combat items and block textures (like swords) to the Daquavis style, featuring a pink theme.
Perfect for PvP minigames/gamemodes like SkyWars, BedWars, or Duels.

This is a fan-made texture pack inspired by the style of Daquavis.
Daquavis is not affiliated with this project and was not involved in its creation.
